releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.1 — 58% Size Reduction (53MB -> 22.3MB), Compressed Native Binaries & Codec Trimming
releaseNotes:
• 58% APK Size Reduction: Reduced release package size from 53.3 MB down to 22.3 MB via native library compression (useLegacyPackaging) and stripping redundant software codecs (AV1 software codec, SoundTouch, VQA extensions) while maintaining full hardware H.264 video and Opus VoIP calling.
• Read Receipts & Double Cyan Ticks (✓✓): Reliable read status reconciliation and instant-sync on peer reply.
• Clean Top Bar UI: Search and Themes moved inside the three-dot overflow menu for maximum contact title clarity.
• Background Consolidated Notifications: 24/7 background push for calls and messages, strictly limited to 1 message card and 1 call card.
